claims.claim: DeepMind began rolling Genie 4 out to trusted testers on October 28, 2026, with wider access planned soon.

claims.claim: MedJev reaches 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM.
claims.episode_span: MedJev, an open System-One model that runs locally on a laptop, reaches 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM while staying within 0.028–0.063 ECE on those knowledge tasks.
claims.source_title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
claims.supporting_quote: MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063).

claims.claim: Lipi-Ghor supplies 885 hours of speaker-diarized long-form Bengali audio from 998 YouTube videos across 17 domains.
claims.episode_span: Lipi-Ghor supplies 885 hours of speaker-diarized long-form Bengali audio from 998 YouTube videos across 17 domains together with SSTT annotations and a human-verified gold split.
claims.source_title: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
claims.supporting_quote: We present Lipi-Ghor, a large-scale weakly-supervised Bengali speech corpus comprising 885 hours of audio sourced from 998 YouTube videos across 596 unique channels, spanning 17 diverse domains including audiobooks, drama, religious sermons, news, and regional dialects.

claims.claim: Instruction tuning on 15 matched base and tuned open-weight model pairs makes number distributions less uniform by installing round-number avoidance and sharpening endpoint avoidance.
claims.episode_span: Instruction tuning on 15 matched base and tuned open-weight model pairs makes number distributions less uniform by installing round-number avoidance and sharpening endpoint avoidance.
claims.supporting_quote: It installs one heuristic, round-number avoidance, and sharpens another, endpoint avoidance.
